title: How do I preview my survey?
intent: This article explains how to preview a survey before publishing.
short_answer: To preview a survey, navigate to the Editor or Overview page and click 'Preview' or 'Test'. This opens the survey in a respondent view so you can see how it will appear to participants. Test submissions can be made without affecting real data.
prerequisites: Survey must have at least one element
procedure: Open the survey Editor or Overview page.
The survey opens in respondent view.
Navigate through the survey as a respondent would.
Submit a test contribution if desired.
Test contributions are marked and can be filtered out from real results.
important_conditions: Preview shows the survey exactly as respondents will see it.
Test contributions submitted through preview are tagged as test data.
Test answers can be excluded from statistics using the 'No test answers' filter.
Preview works for both draft and published surveys.
All question types and dependencies can be tested.
troubleshooting: Preview not showing latest changes: Save the survey in the editor before previewing.
